decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings are a core building block of the firm's compatible drainage families and fit its long-cycle construction range.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's push toward accessible, low-profile bathroom solutions and remains in strong renovation demand.
The designer shower drain is the flagship of the firm's design-focused direction, so withdrawing it is very unlikely.
The DallSafe backflow-protected basement drain serves a durable safety niche that rising heavy-rain risks make more relevant.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral but inexpensive complementary item that rounds out the installer range, so keeping it is still the likely choice.
